identity.name: LogiLink Global
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss precision with Industrial rawness.
Content is King: Data is the hero (Tracking numbers, ETAs).
Zoom In: Focus on the package journey.
Negative Space: Breathing room for complex data.

headings.usage: Use for all major section headers and hero text. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Standard text, UI elements, data tables.

accent.name: International Orange
accent.usage: CTAs, active states, critical alerts. The 'Signal' color.

grid_system.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid (4-col, tight gaps)

rules: No Center-Everything: Use asymmetry for tension.
Breathing Room: Use negative space to highlight data.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-8 py-4 transition-all hover:translate-x-1
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-900 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-8 py-4
buttons.accent: bg-orange-600 text-white hover:bg-orange-700 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-8 py-4 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] hover:shadow-none hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px]

inputs.classes: rounded-none border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-slate-900 focus:ring-0 bg-transparent p-4

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-r and border-b on grid items.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard shadows for buttons (Neo-Brutalist touch), soft ambient shadows for floating elements.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover: slight lift (-2px) + border color change.
motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling momentum.

media.image_style: High contrast, desaturated with preserved accent colors (Orange/Red).

hero.alt: Container ship at sunset near Italy

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use APCA for critical data.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible thick outline (2px solid orange) on focus.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Barlow Condensed' font for all headings.
Use the 'International Orange' (#EA580C) sparingly but boldly for CTAs.
Do not use rounded corners > 4px. Keep it sharp and industrial.
Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections.
Ensure the 'Tracking' input is the most prominent element on the page.
For the dashboard, use the 'High Density Grid' layout.
Apply a subtle noise texture to the background if possible.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. Be bold.
